#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Move this Argo CD estate onto ConfigHub. Written by `cub argo apply`.
# Read it, then run it:
#
#   ARGOCD_CONTEXT=<kubectl context of the cluster Argo CD runs on> bash handover.sh
#
# with DEST_CONTEXT_<cluster>=<kubectl context> for each cluster Argo deploys
# to other than its own: step 0 names any that are missing.
#
# Run apply.sh first. Every step here is a patch, never a delete: the
# objects, their names and Argo's tracking of what they own all survive, so
# no workload is recreated. It goes top down, because a parent pointed at a
# Space that holds nothing prunes the children it applied.
#
# Rehearsed on Argo CD v3.5.3: a repoint preserved every UID, including the
# Pod's, with the rollout revision unchanged. Your estate is not that one.
# Read every step before running it, and start with one non-production
# estate.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
ctx=${ARGOCD_CONTEXT:-$(kubectl config current-context 2>/dev/null || true)}
[ -n "$ctx" ] || { echo "no kubectl context: set ARGOCD_CONTEXT to the cluster Argo CD runs on"; exit 1; }
echo "every kubectl call below uses context $ctx"
k() { kubectl --context "$ctx" "$@"; }
step() { printf '\n== %s\n' "$*"; }
ns=${ARGOCD_NAMESPACE:-argocd}
# The comparison before the template repoint renders from the repository.
REPO_ROOT=${REPO_ROOT:-'<repo>'}
KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS=${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:---enable-helm}

# The gateway address a repointed source reads. cub reports it for a Target.
gateway() { cub target get --space argo-targets "$1" -o jq=.Target.Parameters.OCIRepository 2>/dev/null || true; }

# The state of this run: each parent's source as it was, recorded before it
# moves. If anything stops the script after a parent moved, the way back is
# printed; nothing is rolled back automatically.
state=handover-state/argo.txt; mkdir -p handover-state; touch "$state"; moved=""; finished=0
# While a parent still reads Git, what it reads now is its original, and it
# replaces any earlier record: a handover rolled back and started again may
# find its source changed. Once it reads the gateway, the record stands, for
# the way back from an interrupted run.
record_source() {
  local was; was=$(k -n "$ns" get application "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.spec.source.repoURL}{"|"}{.spec.source.path}{"|"}{.spec.source.targetRevision}')
  case "$was" in *"|oci://"*) return 0 ;; esac
  grep -v "^$1|" "$state" > "$state.new" || true; mv "$state.new" "$state"
  printf '%s\n' "$was" >> "$state"
}
# way_back: leaves first, then parents. Measured on Argo CD v3.5.3: moving
# root back alone puts everything back, every UID intact, but restores the Git
# AppProjects while a generated Application still reads the gateway, which is
# refused until it moves too. Undoing from the bottom avoids that.
way_back() {
  local name url path rev
  echo "  1. Any ApplicationSet you retired (the 'Retire each ApplicationSet' step): if it is a Unit, restore that Unit to the revision before create-only and publish its Space; if it was applied by hand, set its spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync back to what it was on the cluster. Either way the controller then puts its Applications back on the template's Git source."
  echo "  2. Any app of apps repointed through its Unit: restore that Unit to the revision before the repoint, and publish its Space."
  echo "  3. Then each parent patched here:"
  while IFS='|' read -r name url path rev; do
    case " $moved " in *" $name "*) ;; *) [ "${1:-}" = all ] || continue ;; esac
    echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch application $name --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"source\":{\"repoURL\":\"$url\",\"path\":\"$path\",\"targetRevision\":\"$rev\"}}}'"
  done < "$state"
}
stopped() {
  local rc=$?
  [ "$finished" = 1 ] && return
  [ -n "$moved" ] || { echo "Stopped (exit $rc) before any parent's source was changed." >&2; return; }
  echo >&2; echo "HANDOVER STOPPED (exit $rc) on context $ctx. These parents read ConfigHub:$moved" >&2
  echo "Nothing is rolled back automatically. The way back, leaves first:" >&2
  way_back >&2
  echo "Each parent's original source is in $state." >&2
}
trap stopped EXIT

step "0/5 Check before changing anything"
cub auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "cub is not logged in: run cub auth login"; exit 1; }
image=$(k get deployment argocd-repo-server -n "$ns" -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}')
version=${image##*:}; version=${version#v}
if [ "$(printf '%s\n' 3.1 "${version%.*}.${version#*.}" | sort -V | head -1)" != 3.1 ]; then
  echo "Argo CD runs $version; an oci:// source is read natively from v3.1, so this handover is not available here"; exit 1
fi
# Each Application's objects are read on the cluster it deploys to, so each
# cluster other than Argo CD's own needs its kubectl context:
missing=""
[ -n "${DEST_CONTEXT_dev_1:-}" ] || missing="$missing DEST_CONTEXT_dev_1"
[ -n "${DEST_CONTEXT_staging_1:-}" ] || missing="$missing DEST_CONTEXT_staging_1"
[ -n "${DEST_CONTEXT_prod_1:-}" ] || missing="$missing DEST_CONTEXT_prod_1"
[ -z "$missing" ] || { echo "set the kubectl context of each cluster Argo deploys to:$missing"; exit 1; }
# Until the gateway is allowed as a source, every repoint below is refused.
still_blocked=""
k -n "$ns" get appproject platform -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRepos}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q -e 'oci://' -e '"\*"' || still_blocked="$still_blocked platform"
k -n "$ns" get appproject storefront -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRepos}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q -e 'oci://' -e '"\*"' || still_blocked="$still_blocked storefront"
if [ -n "$still_blocked" ]; then
echo 'first, add the gateway'\''s oci:// address to sourceRepos on AppProject platform (allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples) and storefront (allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples): until then every repoint below is refused'
echo "  The address is oci://<gateway host>, the same CONFIGHUB_OCI this script takes:"
echo "    ConfigHub cloud:  oci://oci.hub.confighub.com"
echo "    self-hosted:      oci:// plus the host and port of confighub-oci-server,"
echo "                      as reachable FROM this cluster, not from your laptop."
echo
echo "Change it in GIT, not with kubectl: these AppProjects are synced by an"
echo "Application with selfHeal on, so a patch here is undone within minutes."
echo "Commit the oci:// entry to the file that defines them, let Argo sync it,"
echo "then re-run this script. It re-reads the cluster and will carry on."
read -r -p "Press Return once sourceRepos allows it, or Ctrl-C to stop. " _ || true
else
  echo "sourceRepos already allows an oci:// source on every AppProject this needs."
fi

step "1/5 The credential Argo reads the gateway with"
# A repository Secret for the gateway, holding the Targets' server worker.
# The ID and secret go from cub into the Secret through file descriptors,
# never to disk, the command line, or the terminal.
addr=${CONFIGHUB_OCI:-$(gateway argocd)}
if [ -z "$addr" ]; then
  echo "Could not read the gateway address from Target argo-targets/argocd."
  echo "Find it with: cub target get --space argo-targets argocd"
  echo "then re-run with CONFIGHUB_OCI=<address> bash handover.sh"; exit 1
fi
# The repository Secret's shape was verified against Argo CD v3.5.3:
#   type: oci, url with the oci:// scheme, the worker as username and
#   password. The Application's repoURL needs the scheme too — without it
#   Argo treats the address as a git repository and fails on "list refs".
# insecureOCIForceHttp is only for a gateway served over plain HTTP.
plain_http=""
[ -n "${CONFIGHUB_OCI_PLAIN_HTTP:-}" ] && plain_http='  insecureOCIForceHttp: "true"'
cat <<YAML | k apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: confighub-argo-targets
  namespace: ${ns}
  labels:
    argocd.argoproj.io/secret-type: repo-creds
stringData:
  type: oci
  url: oci://${addr}
  username: "$(cub worker get --space argo-targets server-worker -o jq=.BridgeWorker.BridgeWorkerID | tr -d '\n')"
  password: "$(cub worker get --space argo-targets server-worker --include-secret -o jq=.BridgeWorker.Secret | tr -d '\n')"
${plain_http}
YAML

step "2/5 Repoint root at argo-root-children"
# Its children are Units there by now, released to the argocd Target.
record_source 'root'
k -n "$ns" get application root -o jsonpath='{.spec.source.repoURL}' | grep -q '^oci://' && echo 'root already reads ConfigHub' || \
  k -n "$ns" patch application root --type merge -p "{\"spec\":{\"source\":{\"repoURL\":\"oci://${addr}/space/argo-root-children\",\"path\":\".\",\"targetRevision\":\"latest\"}}}"
# Argo caches the digest it resolved for a tag, so a repoint alone can
# leave it serving the release it read before. A hard refresh re-resolves
# the tag, and is what argobot issues on every release.published.
moved="$moved root"
k -n "$ns" annotate application root argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite
for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
  st=$(k -n "$ns" get application root -o jsonpath='{.status.sync.status}' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$st" ] && [ "$st" != Unknown ] && break
  sleep 5
done
st=$(k -n "$ns" get application root -o jsonpath='{.status.sync.status}')
if [ "$st" = Unknown ] || [ -z "$st" ]; then
  echo "root could not read argo-root-children:" >&2
  k -n "$ns" get application root -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[*].message}' >&2; echo >&2
  exit 1
fi
want=$(cub release get --space argo-root-children --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
got=""; for _ in $(seq 1 36); do
  got=$(k -n "$ns" get application root -o jsonpath='{.status.sync.revision}')
  [ "$got" = "$want" ] && break
  sleep 5
done
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
  echo "  root synced ${got:-nothing it reports}, not argo-root-children's newest release $want" >&2; exit 1
fi
echo "  root reads argo-root-children at $got ($st; a parent reads OutOfSync until its children move too)"
step "3/5 Repoint storefront at argo-storefront-children"
# Its children are Units there by now, released to the argocd Target.
echo "storefront is a Unit in argo-root-children now, which root syncs from ConfigHub."
echo "Patching it here would be undone on the next reconcile. Change it where it"
echo "is defined, then let it flow down:"
echo "  cub unit data --space argo-root-children storefront-app-of-apps > storefront-app-of-apps.yaml"
echo "  # set spec.source.repoURL to oci://${addr}/space/argo-storefront-children, path '.', targetRevision latest"
echo "  cub unit update --space argo-root-children storefront-app-of-apps storefront-app-of-apps.yaml"
echo "  cub release publish argo-root-children"
echo "That is a reviewed change, which is the point of it being a Unit."
step "4/5 Prove nothing on the clusters would change"
# Two questions, and only the second can see the cluster.
#
# Does what ConfigHub holds equal what the overlay renders today? That
# compares two things both derived from Git, so it catches Git moving
# since apply.sh, and nothing else.
command -v kustomize >/dev/null || { echo "kustomize is not on PATH; this step re-renders with it"; exit 1; }
[ -d "$REPO_ROOT" ] || { echo "REPO_ROOT=$REPO_ROOT is not a directory: point it at the repository checkout"; exit 1; }
echo "  rendering with $(kustomize version)"
if ! git -C "$REPO_ROOT" diff --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "  note: $REPO_ROOT has uncommitted changes, so this renders something Argo is not applying" >&2
fi
same() {
  local fresh got rc=0
  fresh=$(mktemp); got=$(mktemp)
  kustomize build ${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:-} "$REPO_ROOT/$3" > "$fresh" || { rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return 1; }
  cub unit data --space "$1" "$2" > "$got" || { rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return 1; }
  if diff -q <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$fresh") <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$got") >/dev/null; then
    echo "  $1 holds what $3 renders today"
  else
    echo "  $1 DIFFERS from what $3 renders today. Re-run apply.sh, then read the diff." >&2
    diff -u <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$fresh") <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$got") | head -40 >&2
    rc=1
  fi
  rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return $rc
}

# And the one that matters: does what ConfigHub would deliver equal what
# Argo owns on the cluster right now? Argo's own status.resources is the
# record, so this sees objects that are on the cluster and not in Git at
# all. Where Argo prunes, those would be deleted the moment the source
# moves. No render-side check can see them.
same 'argo-apptique-dev-1' 'apptique' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/dev'
digest_argo_apptique_dev_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-apptique-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'dev-1-apptique' --space 'argo-apptique-dev-1' --unit 'apptique' --destination-namespace 'storefront-dev' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_dev_1" --destination 'https://dev-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_apptique_dev_1"
same 'argo-apptique-staging-1' 'apptique' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/staging'
digest_argo_apptique_staging_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-apptique-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'staging-1-apptique' --space 'argo-apptique-staging-1' --unit 'apptique' --destination-namespace 'storefront-staging' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_staging_1" --destination 'https://staging-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_apptique_staging_1"
same 'argo-apptique-prod-1' 'apptique' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/prod'
digest_argo_apptique_prod_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-apptique-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'prod-1-apptique' --space 'argo-apptique-prod-1' --unit 'apptique' --destination-namespace 'storefront-prod' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_prod_1" --destination 'https://prod-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_apptique_prod_1"
same 'argo-checkout-cache-dev-1' 'checkout-cache' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/dev'
digest_argo_checkout_cache_dev_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-checkout-cache-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'dev-1-checkout-cache' --space 'argo-checkout-cache-dev-1' --unit 'checkout-cache' --destination-namespace 'storefront-dev' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_dev_1" --destination 'https://dev-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_checkout_cache_dev_1"
same 'argo-checkout-cache-staging-1' 'checkout-cache' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/staging'
digest_argo_checkout_cache_staging_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-checkout-cache-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'staging-1-checkout-cache' --space 'argo-checkout-cache-staging-1' --unit 'checkout-cache' --destination-namespace 'storefront-staging' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_staging_1" --destination 'https://staging-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_checkout_cache_staging_1"
same 'argo-checkout-cache-prod-1' 'checkout-cache' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/prod'
digest_argo_checkout_cache_prod_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-checkout-cache-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'prod-1-checkout-cache' --space 'argo-checkout-cache-prod-1' --unit 'checkout-cache' --destination-namespace 'storefront-prod' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_prod_1" --destination 'https://prod-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_checkout_cache_prod_1"
same 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1' 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/dev'
digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_dev_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'dev-1-cluster-baseline' --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1' --unit 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' --destination-namespace 'platform-system' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_dev_1" --destination 'https://dev-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_dev_1"
same 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1' 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/staging'
digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_staging_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'staging-1-cluster-baseline' --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1' --unit 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' --destination-namespace 'platform-system' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_staging_1" --destination 'https://staging-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_staging_1"
same 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1' 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/prod'
digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_prod_1=$(cub release get --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
cub argo check --kube-context "$ctx" --fields --namespace "$ns" --application 'prod-1-cluster-baseline' --space 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1' --unit 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline' --destination-namespace 'platform-system' --destination-context "$DEST_CONTEXT_prod_1" --destination 'https://prod-1.example.invalid' --release "$digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_prod_1"

# What no controller claims on these namespaces, as a cross-check. This
# is cub-scout inferring ownership, not a gate: it finds what was applied
# by hand and would be left behind, which neither record above reports.
if command -v cub-scout >/dev/null || cub scout --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cub scout map list -q 'owner=Native AND namespace=storefront-dev AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt' || true
  cub scout map list -q 'owner=Native AND namespace=storefront-staging AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt' || true
  cub scout map list -q 'owner=Native AND namespace=storefront-prod AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt' || true
  cub scout map list -q 'owner=Native AND namespace=platform-system AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt' || true
else
  echo "  cub-scout is not installed; skipping the unclaimed-resource cross-check"
fi

step "5/5 Retire each ApplicationSet, then point its Applications at their Spaces"
# An ApplicationSet generates one Application per cluster from ONE shared
# template, so it cannot give each cluster its own Space by editing that
# template with a literal. ConfigHub already holds the fleet enumerated --
# one variant Space per cluster, staged -- so the generator has nothing left
# to generate. It is retired, and each Application it made is pointed at its
# own Space: a literal address, one cluster at a time, which is what makes a
# staged rollout possible at all.
#
# Measured on Argo CD v3.5.3: patching a generated Application while its
# ApplicationSet is live is reverted in under a second, so the generator has
# to stand down FIRST. applicationsSync: create-only is what stands it down;
# the controller then creates but never updates or deletes what it made.

echo '-- apptique'
echo 'apptique is a Unit in argo-storefront-children. Retire it where ConfigHub keeps it, so the change is reviewed and survives the next sync:'
echo '  cub unit data --space argo-storefront-children apptique > apptique.yaml'
echo '  # set spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync: create-only'
echo '  #   and annotate it argo.confighub.com/retired: "retired at handover; see cleanup.sh"'
echo '  cub unit update --space argo-storefront-children apptique apptique.yaml'
echo '  cub release publish argo-storefront-children'
echo '  # then wait for the parent to sync it down before patching anything:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'get applicationset apptique -o jsonpath='\''{.spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync}'\''' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo 'Once it reads create-only, point each Application at its own Space:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application dev-1-apptique --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-apptique-dev-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage canary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_apptique_dev_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application staging-1-apptique --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-apptique-staging-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage secondary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_apptique_staging_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application prod-1-apptique --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-apptique-prod-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage primary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_apptique_prod_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"

echo '-- checkout-cache'
echo 'checkout-cache is a Unit in argo-storefront-children. Retire it where ConfigHub keeps it, so the change is reviewed and survives the next sync:'
echo '  cub unit data --space argo-storefront-children checkout-cache > checkout-cache.yaml'
echo '  # set spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync: create-only'
echo '  #   and annotate it argo.confighub.com/retired: "retired at handover; see cleanup.sh"'
echo '  cub unit update --space argo-storefront-children checkout-cache checkout-cache.yaml'
echo '  cub release publish argo-storefront-children'
echo '  # then wait for the parent to sync it down before patching anything:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'get applicationset checkout-cache -o jsonpath='\''{.spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync}'\''' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo 'Once it reads create-only, point each Application at its own Space:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application dev-1-checkout-cache --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-checkout-cache-dev-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage canary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_checkout_cache_dev_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application staging-1-checkout-cache --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-checkout-cache-staging-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage secondary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_checkout_cache_staging_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application prod-1-checkout-cache --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-checkout-cache-prod-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage primary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_checkout_cache_prod_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"

echo '-- platform-addons'
echo 'platform-addons is a Unit in argo-root-children. Retire it where ConfigHub keeps it, so the change is reviewed and survives the next sync:'
echo '  cub unit data --space argo-root-children platform-addons-appset > platform-addons-appset.yaml'
echo '  # set spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync: create-only'
echo '  #   and annotate it argo.confighub.com/retired: "retired at handover; see cleanup.sh"'
echo '  cub unit update --space argo-root-children platform-addons-appset platform-addons-appset.yaml'
echo '  cub release publish argo-root-children'
echo '  # then wait for the parent to sync it down before patching anything:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'get applicationset platform-addons -o jsonpath='\''{.spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync}'\''' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo 'Once it reads create-only, point each Application at its own Space:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application dev-1-cluster-baseline --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage canary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_dev_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application staging-1-cluster-baseline --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage secondary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_staging_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'patch application prod-1-cluster-baseline --type merge -p '\''{"spec":{"source":{"repoURL":"oci://<gateway>/space/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1","path":".","targetRevision":"latest"}}}'\''   # stage primary' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo "    # checked at ${digest_argo_platform_addons_cluster_baseline_prod_1:-?}; once synced, its status.sync.revision should name that digest, or a newer release went out unchecked"

echo 'Each Application keeps its name and its UID, so nothing is orphaned and no'
echo 'workload restarts. The retired ApplicationSets stay in place, inert. Removing'
echo 'them is a separate, later decision: cleanup.sh has the one safe way.'
echo 'Note: AppProject storefront denies syncing prod-1-apptique, prod-1-checkout-cache on schedule "0 9 * * 1-5" for 9h. The repoint lands, but its first sync waits for the window to close.'

echo
echo 'Done once every Application reports Synced from an oci:// source:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'get applications -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,SOURCE:.spec.source.repoURL,SYNC:.status.sync.status' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
finished=1
echo 'Nothing was deleted. The way back, leaves first:'
way_back all
echo
echo 'One more thing, measured on Argo CD v3.5.3: publishing a new release does NOT'
echo 'reach the cluster on its own. Argo caches the digest it resolved for the tag, and'
echo 'was still serving the previous release 90 seconds later. A hard refresh re-resolves'
echo 'the tag to a digest and the release lands:'
printf '  kubectl --context %s -n %s %s\n' "$ctx" "$ns" "$(printf '%s' 'annotate application <name> argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite' | sed "s|<gateway>|${addr:-<gateway>}|")"
echo 'argobot does this for you, reacting to ConfigHub'\''s release.published event. Without'
echo 'argobot, keep this running beside the cluster: it asks for that refresh once per'
echo 'release, and writes what Argo synced into each Space as ConfigHub live status, which'
echo 'is what the Healthy gate and change orders read:'
echo "  cub argo status <what you planned, with the same flags> --prefix argo --kube-context $ctx --watch --hard-refresh"
